// diagnostic

E0390

`{name}` is a compile-time `{value_type}` parameter, and only `Int` number parameters exist.

What

`{name}` is a compile-time `{value_type}` parameter, and only `Int` number parameters exist.

Why

An instance of the declaration is named by its number arguments (`Packet<4>`), which are whole numbers known while compiling.

Fix

Declare it `comptime {name}: Int`, or make it a type parameter or an ordinary argument.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0390: tests/ui/prep_number_param_must_be_int.stderr.

Error [jet.CompileTimeNumberParameter]: `N` is a compile-time `String` parameter, and only `Int` number parameters exist.
  --> tests/ui/prep_number_param_must_be_int.jet:3:25
    |
  3 | Packet: struct<comptime N: String> {
    |                         ^
 Why: An instance of the declaration is named by its number arguments (`Packet<4>`), which are whole numbers known while compiling.
 Fix: Declare it `comptime N: Int`, or make it a type parameter or an ordinary argument.
